title: The Hop Shoppe
venue_description:
The Hop Shoppe

The Hop Shoppe is a gastropub near the Staten Island Ferry Terminal in St. George, serving as a full-service restaurant and bar with a lively late-night crowd and a regular live-entertainment schedule.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Hop Shoppe has the feel of a modern American gastropub — a full menu, an extensive drink list and a comfortable bar area that easily converts into a performance space on open mic nights.

The Table Open Mic

Every Sunday, sign-up begins at 7:30 PM for The Table, an open mic welcoming singers, musicians and poets for seven to ten minute sets. Host Donny Teachout keeps the night moving, with DJ Omarolusion running sound. There is no cover charge, though a ten dollar food or drink purchase is suggested, and reserving a seat by calling ahead is recommended given the venue's popularity.

Other Programming

The Hop Shoppe keeps late hours most nights of the week as a neighborhood gastropub, with the Sunday open mic serving as its signature recurring performance night alongside its regular restaurant and bar service.

Good to Know

The Hop Shoppe is located at 372 Van Duzer Street, a short walk from the Staten Island Ferry Terminal, making it an easy stop for visitors arriving by ferry from Manhattan.

title: Every Thing Goes Book Cafe and Neighborhood Stage
venue_description:
Every Thing Goes Book Cafe and Neighborhood Stage

Every Thing Goes is an independent bookstore cafe in St. George that has doubled as a community performance stage since 2005, making it one of Staten Island's longest-running homes for grassroots arts programming.

Atmosphere and Setting

The cafe blends a used bookstore with a small stage and cafe seating, creating a warm, unpretentious space that feels more like a community living room than a traditional venue. It is open Wednesday through Saturday during the day and stays open later on event nights.

Liberation Open Mic

Held roughly monthly on a Friday evening from 7:00 PM to 8:30 PM, the Liberation Open Mic welcomes a poem, a song, a guitar or ukulele, artwork or anything else performers want to share. It is an all-media, all-genres night with a five dollar suggested donation and no one turned away for lack of funds.

Staten Island Songwriters' Circle

Held roughly monthly on a Saturday evening from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM, the Songwriters' Circle brings together local singer-songwriters to share original material in a supportive, low-key setting, with a five dollar cover.

Other Programming

Beyond its two open-format nights, the cafe hosts a rotating calendar of curated musical showcases and poetry nights, including community concerts and themed songwriter events throughout the year.

Good to Know

Every Thing Goes is located at 208 Bay Street in St. George, an easy walk from the Staten Island Ferry Terminal. Contact the cafe directly to confirm upcoming dates, as both recurring series run on a roughly monthly rather than weekly schedule.

title: Curly Wolf Saloon
venue_description:
Curly Wolf Saloon

Curly Wolf Saloon is a neighborhood bar on Staten Island's south shore that has built a reputation for live music and community events alongside its regular bar service.

Atmosphere and Setting

The saloon has a relaxed, small-bar feel, with a regular crowd that mixes music fans with neighborhood drinkers, giving performers a genuine local audience.

Brian's Open Mike

On the last Wednesday of the month starting at 8:00 PM, host Brian Smith runs an open mic welcoming solo performers and full bands across all musical styles, plus poetry. House bass and drums are available on-site, making it easy for musicians to sit in without hauling a full backline.

Other Programming

Curly Wolf Saloon hosts additional live-music nights throughout the year as part of its regular bar entertainment calendar.

Good to Know

Curly Wolf Saloon is located at 4116 Hylan Boulevard on Staten Island's south shore. Because the open mic runs monthly, calling ahead to confirm the date is recommended.
